skill.name: neon-postgres
skill.description: Guides Neon Serverless Postgres setup, runtime-specific connections, branching, authentication, scaling, pooling, recovery, and automation with official documentation.
skill.summary: Configure and operate Neon Postgres across local, serverless, and production environments.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, code fences, official links, and standard process.env examples. Confirmed risks are unattended remote installation, cloud-changing Neon CLI commands, and instructions to inspect .env files containing database credentials. No prompt injection or exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned packages run through npx with automatic confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Pin package versions, verify package identity, and request explicit approval before installing CLI, MCP, extension, or skill components.

remediation.issue: The setup flow may read .env files containing database credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Check variable presence without displaying values, redact credentials, and update only DATABASE_URL while preserving existing file content.

remediation.issue: Neon apply, deploy, checkout, and provisioning commands can change cloud resources.
remediation.suggestion: Show the plan and request explicit approval before resource creation, configuration application, authentication provisioning, or destructive actions.

content.value_statement: Choosing safe Neon connection and deployment patterns can be difficult across runtimes. This skill guides setup, drivers, branching, authentication, scaling, and automation using current Neon documentation.
actual_capabilities: Selects Neon connection drivers for persistent, edge, and isolated serverless runtimes.
Guides project setup with the Neon CLI, MCP server, environment variables, and supported ORMs.
Explains database branching, instant restore, read replicas, autoscaling, and scale-to-zero.
Provides connection pooling guidance for PgBouncer, node-postgres, and Neon serverless drivers.
Covers Neon Auth, REST API, TypeScript SDK, Python SDK, and infrastructure configuration.
Links recommendations to official Neon documentation for current implementation details.
limitations: The skill does not provide Neon credentials, accounts, subscriptions, or project access.
Commands and service behavior require verification against current Neon documentation before execution.
Examples require adaptation and testing for each framework, runtime, security model, and deployment platform.
Cloud changes, credential handling, and package installation require user review and approval.
